mapper.sql: b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,b.bill_no,b.prj_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name, p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt,b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt,b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt, b.rcpt_plan_dt,b.amnd_yn,b.orgnl_bill_id
FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id
mapper.select: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stts_cd,b.amnd_yn,b.orgnl_bill_id FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND b.amnd_yn='Y' ORDER BY b.bill_id

SELECT b.tot_amt::numeric + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0) AS adjusted_total_amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0) AS received_amt FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,n.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym, d.mm_qty,m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty, d.ovtm_tm_qty,d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=d.cntrct_dev_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt DESC,r.rcpt_id DESC
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{billId} AND r.rcpt_id=#{receiptId}

SELECT h.data_chg_ty_cd || ' · ' || COALESCE(h.bfr_val,'') || ' → ' || COALESCE(h.aft_val,'') AS description,h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text)) OR (h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' AND h.rsn_desc='bill_id=' || CAST(#{id} AS text)) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.rcpt SET rcpt_dt=#{input.rcpt_dt},rcpt_amt=#{input.rcpt_amt},rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc} WHERE bill_id=#{billId} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bill.rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{billId} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
